name: Band Woodchop
steps: Anchor a resistance band above head height, stand sideways to the anchor, and grip the band with both hands extended toward the anchor.
Set your feet slightly wider than shoulder width and brace your core with your arms mostly straight.
Pull the band diagonally down and across your torso toward your opposite hip while rotating your chest and pivoting your back foot.
Return smoothly along the same diagonal arc under control, then turn around to repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Drive the diagonal chop through your hips and obliques while keeping your arms long.
Control the return slowly so the band does not snap your torso back toward the anchor.
